name: web-black-and-lime-autonomous-ride-landing-sections
title: Black and Lime Autonomous Ride Landing
whatItIs: A tall landing page collage on lime: a black rounded panel with numbered feature cards staggered in lime, white, grey, then a centered slogan 'No driver. No wait. Just ride.' surrounded by avatar bubbles and stats, and a photo hero below.
whatItMeans: Black and neon lime feel bold, futuristic and fast. Staggered cards and floating stat pills add rhythm.
techniques: Lime highlight block behind the key words of a slogan
Staggered numbered cards forming a stair pattern
Floating avatar circles and stat pills around a headline
Full lime outer frame around a black rounded page

vocabulary.definition: A solid coloured shape behind selected text.
Cards placed at alternating heights forming steps.
A small rounded badge holding a number and label.
